author: carlosjcc
quote: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time was developed in less time and with a fraction of GTA 6’s budget, yet it’s a much better-made game. A true masterpiece that proves a massive budget doesn’t guarantee quality. Meanwhile, GTA 6 doesn’t even offer voice acting in other languages, including Spanish. Ocarina of Time remains one of the greatest games ever made!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: carlosjcc
quote: How is it possible that a $100 game, after so many years in development and with such a massive budget, doesn’t offer voice acting in multiple languages, especially Spanish?I personally don’t play games unless they have Spanish voice acting. I purchased this game expecting better, and despite requesting a refund, PlayStation refused to give me ****’s extremely disappointing that a game of this scale doesn’t include something as basic as Spanish dubbing, especially when so many other AAA titles with similar budgets offer it.Once Spanish voice acting is added, I’ll finally be able to enjoy the game and give it a fair review. Until then, I simply can’t recommend it.
